items.title: These 6 Massive Dividend Yields May Be Too Good to Be True
items.summary: A fat dividend yield can signal a stock worth buying or a company quietly falling apart, and telling the difference requires looking past the payout itself at the cash flow, debt load, and share price collapse hiding behind the number.

items.title: Why Is Kraft Heinz (KHC) Out Of Two Major Stock Indexes?
items.summary: Kraft Heinz (NYSE:KHC) has been removed from both the Nasdaq Composite and NASDAQ-100 indexes, effective immediately. The exit from these Nasdaq benchmarks reduces KHC's presence in index-tracking funds that mirror those indices. The change may influence how some institutional investors and ETFs that follow Nasdaq indices gain exposure to Kraft Heinz.
